_comment: Melee weapon ladder spec (#631). The melee counterpart to ranged_ladders.json.
The unit is SUSTAINED damage (DPS), not one blow. A lighter blade that swings faster can
out-damage a heavier one, so ranking on the displayed damage number gets those backwards.
See docs/features/melee-damage-model.md for how DPS is derived and what its limits are.
WHY THIS EXISTS. Measured 2026-09-20 across 364 Armory melee weapons and 858 troops, the
median best-DPS per engine tier ran 66, 64, 66, 67, 69, 69, 81, 82, 82, 69 for tiers 1 to
10. That is a 1.04x climb. Vanilla climbs 2.23x over five tiers (30, 50, 58, 60, 67). Troop
tier had almost no bearing on melee output, and the capstone tier was armed below tier 7.
THE ANCHOR. TAOM's tier-5 median of 69 already matched vanilla's tier-5 median of 67, so
the midpoint was never the problem and is held fixed. The curve below fans out around it at
vanilla's own slope of roughly +9 DPS per tier. Changing `curve` changes the whole mod's
melee power distribution; changing `anchor_tier` moves what stays put while you do it.
KINGDOM OFFSETS are carried over from tools/rebalance_weapons.py CULTURAL_POINTS, which is
the existing per-culture craftsmanship table, so faction flavour survives the flattening
fix. They are a percentage of the tier target, not flat DPS, so they scale with the curve.
The band is what counts as on-curve. Too tight and every roster is a finding; too loose and
the ladder does not mean anything. 0.25 leaves 46% of troops already correct.
_kingdom_comment: Percentage shift applied to the tier target for a troop of this culture. Keys are engine
culture StringIds, which is what a troop's culture= attribute carries: TAOM remaps several
vanilla ids (vlandia is Rohan, empire and battania are Dunland, aserai is Harad, khuzait is
Rhun, sturgia is Dale). A culture absent from this table takes the plain tier target.
_ceiling_comment: No weapon may out-sustain this, in DPS, except the hero blades named in the exempt list.
140 is vanilla's own demonstrated maximum: the hardest-sustaining vanilla melee weapon
measured 138 DPS. Holding TAOM to it is what 'no weapon too OP' means numerically. 65
_exempt_comment: Named hero weapons, which are meant to sit above the curve. Keyed by BLADE PIECE, because
that is what a restat edits and what a shared blade drags along with it. Carried over from
tools/rebalance_weapons.py HERO_BLADE_IDS so the two agree on who is exempt.
_exempt_troops_comment: Troops deliberately off the ladder, each with a stated reason. An entry naming a troop that

exempt_troops.cave_troll: A troll is a monster, not a soldier. Its weapons are scenery-scale and deliberately slow, and the creature's threat comes from its own attacks and its mass rather than from its kit sustaining tier-10 DPS.
exempt_troops.hill_troll: The same monster rule as the cave troll: the hill troll carries the cave troll's two-handed mace on its own 3.6 m skeleton (2026-09-25).
